meta.description: A SHAREit alternative with no ads and no tracking: BIShare sends files fast over Wi-Fi or a browser link — end-to-end encrypted, on every platform, free and no account.

hero.title: A SHAREit alternative without the clutter
hero.body: SHAREit gets your files across — but it arrives loaded with ads, pop-ups, a news feed, and background trackers. BIShare is the clean alternative: send files fast over your local Wi-Fi or with a simple browser link, end-to-end encrypted, on iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, and Linux. No ads, no account, nothing watching you.

why.title: Why leave SHAREit behind
why.body: SHAREit earned its users on cross-platform transfer — then filled up with ads, app recommendations, and trackers that follow you around. You only wanted to move a file. BIShare keeps that one job clean: direct, end-to-end-encrypted transfer with no ads, no bundled extras, and nothing collecting your data. It's quick when you're on the same Wi-Fi, and effortless when you're across the country.

0.b: Files travel straight from one device to the other, end-to-end encrypted — never uploaded to a server. It's fast, and it still works over a phone hotspot with no internet connection at all.

1.b: You get a link, a QR code, and a 6-character code. The other person opens the link in any browser and downloads — no app, no sign-up on their side. The link auto-expires after 24 hours.

2.b: iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, and Linux — one app, every direction. Send a phone photo to a laptop, or a folder to someone on a different operating system entirely.

0.a: BIShare. It does what people liked about SHAREit — fast, cross-platform transfer between phones and computers — but stays clean: no ads, no news feed, no trackers. On the same Wi-Fi it sends directly, device to device; when you're apart it hands you a link the other person opens in any browser.

1.q: Is there a SHAREit alternative with no ads or tracking?
1.a: Yes — that's exactly why BIShare exists. There are no ads, no pop-ups, no bundled apps, and no analytics profiling you. Nearby transfers happen directly between your devices and never touch a server, and there's no account to create.

2.q: Is BIShare more secure than SHAREit?
2.a: Every BIShare transfer is end-to-end encrypted, so only the sender and receiver can read the files. Nearby transfers go straight from device to device without passing through the cloud, and there's no account or personal data to collect in the first place.

3.q: Do both people need to install BIShare?
3.a: No. For a share link, the other person just opens it in any browser and downloads — no app, no account on their end. Installing the app makes nearby transfers faster and unlocks every feature, but it's never required to receive a file.

4.q: Is BIShare free, and how large can files be?
4.a: Yes — free, with no account. Nearby transfers over your own network have no size limit. Share links handle large files up to 10 GB for free and expire automatically after 24 hours, on any platform.

cta.title: Transfer files the clean way
cta.body: Free, no account, no ads. Install BIShare on your phone or computer and start sending — the other side doesn't even need the app.
